nodes.label: Expensable Project
nodes.rationale: Personal/family expense tracker that ingests CSV, PDF, and receipt images, extracts transactions via AI, and provides a dashboard with insights, subscription detection, and categorization.

nodes.label: Turborepo Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Turborepo + npm workspaces monorepo with apps/web, apps/mobile, packages/types, packages/utils, packages/db, packages/api-client

nodes.label: Next.js 16 Breaking Change Rules
nodes.rationale: cookies(), headers(), draftMode(), params, searchParams are ALL async; middleware file is proxy.ts; Turbopack is default; no serverRuntimeConfig; after() is stable since v15.1

nodes.label: Auth System (NextAuth v5)
nodes.rationale: NextAuth v5 beta with Google OAuth + email/password, JWT sessions, Prisma adapter, route protection via proxy.ts

nodes.label: proxy.ts (Middleware)
nodes.rationale: Named proxy.ts (not middleware.ts) in Next.js 16; exports proxy function for route protection

nodes.label: File Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Upload → magic-byte validation → MinIO storage → after() fires processFile() → AI parsing → transactions written to DB

nodes.label: Magic-Byte File Validation
nodes.rationale: MIME type alone is not trusted; validates PDF=%PDF, JPEG=FFD8FF, PNG=89504E47, WebP=RIFF, CSV=UTF-8 text before storage

nodes.label: Google Cloud Storage (Production)
nodes.rationale: Key pattern: households/{householdId}/files/{fileId}/{filename}; auth via GCS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY env

nodes.label: AI Parser (lib/ai/parser.ts)
nodes.rationale: Dispatches to Claude or Ollama based on env; sanitizes input before parsing

nodes.label: Ollama Cloud API
nodes.rationale: Used for AI parsing; model default gemma4; supports CSV and images but NOT PDF (not supported by Ollama cloud)

nodes.label: AI Prompt Injection Sanitizer (lib/ai/sanitize.ts)
nodes.rationale: Strips 17 injection patterns, caps cells at 500 chars to prevent prompt injection attacks

nodes.label: processFile() Function
nodes.rationale: Applies null-safety fallbacks for currency/date, maps categoryHint to system Category rows, sets needsReview when data is incomplete

nodes.label: Auto-Categorization System
nodes.rationale: Maps categoryHint to system Category rows; other/transfer/no match → Other + needsReview=true; ensureCategories() lazy-seeds on first call

nodes.label: Household DB Model
nodes.rationale: defaultCurrency String @default('USD') — per-household currency preference

nodes.label: Neon Postgres (Database)
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL = Neon pooled (pgbouncer, runtime); DIRECT_URL = Neon direct (migrations only)

nodes.label: PLANS Constant (Subscription Tiers)
nodes.rationale: free: 25 files/month 1 member; pro: 60 files/month 1 member; family: 1000 files/month 6 members

nodes.label: UI Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark sidebar (slate-950), emerald accent, white cards rounded-2xl on slate-50 background; no overflow-hidden on table cards (clips dropdowns)

nodes.label: Onboarding Wizard (Phase 3.5)
nodes.rationale: 5-step intro wizard shown once to new users on both web and mobile; DB field User.onboardingCompleted

nodes.label: Dashboard Analytics
nodes.rationale: Shows money in/out/net (current month), recent 6 transactions, top 5 merchants by debit; amounts formatted with Intl.NumberFormat using household defaultCurrency

nodes.label: Security Measures
nodes.rationale: Implemented by SuperSecGuy: magic-byte validation, AI injection sanitization, rate limiting (10 uploads/min), generic error messages, Zod input validation, IDOR protection

nodes.label: Phase 2: File Upload + AI Parsing + Security
nodes.norm_label: phase 2: file upload + ai parsing + security

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: This version of Next.js has breaking changes from training data; agent must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code

nodes.label: apps/mobile/.expo README
nodes.rationale: .expo folder created by expo start; contains devices.json and settings.json; should NOT be committed to git

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Project has knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with god nodes, community structure, cross-file relationships; use graphify query/path/explain before raw grep

nodes.label: Turbopack (Build Tool)
nodes.rationale: Default for both dev and build in Next.js 16

nodes.label: Expensable Blue X / Arrow Logo Mark
nodes.norm_label: expensable blue x / arrow logo mark
